import sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.')
import parse
import re

    ('{a}b', 'OK'),
    ('a{a}', 'OK'),
    ('{a}{b}', 'OK'),
    ('{{a}}', 'OK'),
    ('{a b}', 'OK'),
    ('{a', None),  # unclosed
    ('a}', None),  # unmatched close
    ('{} {}', 'OK'),
]

for fmt, expected in tests:
    try:
        p = parse.Parser(fmt)
        print(f'{fmt!r}: expression={p._expression!r}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{fmt!r}: ERROR - {e}')
"
